title: Luke Bible Quiz - Chapter 12
description: Ten questions on Luke 12: the yeast of the Pharisees, the rich man and his barns, the ravens and the lilies, and being ready.

questions.text: What does he call the yeast of the Pharisees?
questions.explanation: He warns his disciples to beware of the yeast of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

answers.text: Hypocrisy
Covetousness
Unbelief
Drunkenness

questions.text: What does he say will happen to what is spoken in the ear in the inner rooms?
questions.explanation: He says that what has been said in the darkness will be heard in the light, and what was spoken in the ear in the inner rooms will be proclaimed on the housetops.

answers.text: It will be forgotten by morning
It will stay hidden until the judgment
It will be proclaimed on the housetops
It will be written in a book

questions.text: What does he say about the hairs of your head?
questions.explanation: He says that the very hairs of your head are all counted, so they should not be afraid, since they are of more value than many sparrows.

answers.text: They are of little value
They are all counted
They turn white with worry
They are numbered only by angels

questions.text: What did one of the multitude ask him to tell his brother to do?
questions.explanation: One of the multitude asked him to tell his brother to divide the inheritance with him.

answers.text: Forgive him seven times
Give him a goat to celebrate with
Pay him the very last penny
Divide the inheritance with him

questions.text: In the parable, what did the rich man plan to do because he had no room for his crops?
questions.explanation: The rich man said he would pull down his barns and build bigger ones, and store all his grain and goods there.

answers.text: Pull down his barns and build bigger ones
Sell his grain in the city
Give his crops to the needy
Rent a storehouse from his neighbor

questions.text: What did God say to the rich man in the parable?
questions.explanation: God said, "You foolish one, tonight your soul is required of you. The things which you have prepared - whose will they be?"

answers.text: That his barns would be burned
That his soul was required of him that very night
That his servants would rob him
That he would live many more years

questions.text: What does he say about the lilies and Solomon?
questions.explanation: He says the lilies do not toil or spin, yet even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

answers.text: Solomon planted them in his garden
They were woven into Solomon's robes
Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of them
Solomon was clothed more beautifully than they are

questions.text: What does he say about where your treasure is?
questions.explanation: He says that where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

answers.text: Your enemies will find it
Moths will destroy it
It will be repaid to you twice
Your heart will be there also

questions.text: What does he say is required of the one to whom much is given?
questions.explanation: He says that to whomever much is given, of him much will be required, and of him to whom much was entrusted, more will be asked.

answers.text: He will be forgiven much
Much will be required of him
He will be given even more without asking
He will be beaten with few stripes

questions.text: What do people say when they see a cloud rising from the west?
questions.explanation: He says that when they see a cloud rising from the west they immediately say, "A shower is coming," and so it happens.

answers.text: "There will be a scorching heat"
"The harvest is near"
"A shower is coming"
"A wind storm is coming down on the lake"
